citation: Florida judge grants protective order against US Rep. Cory Mills at request of ex-girlfriend
title: Florida judge grants protective order against US Rep. Cory Mills at request of ex-girlfriend
notes: A substitute for ABC News's report, of which Wayback holds no capture: an Associated Press story, as The Daily Record ran it, printed By: Associated Press, October 22, 2025, 9:38 am (13:38 UTC), datelined LAKE CITY, Florida; it says the order was issued Tuesday. The capture is of 2025-10-24. The AP's own copy was not sought.
